description: List one level of the workspace's media folders: the top-level folders, or the direct children of parentId - walk deeper by passing a returned id as parentId. Read-only, no paging. Returns { count, total, items: [{ id, name, parentId }] }. Use an id as folderId for upload_media or move_media; create a folder with create_media_folder, rename or move one with update_media_folder.

parentId.description: List the folders directly under this parent folder id; omit for the top-level folders

name: list_media_folders
title: List media folders
